title: 第274章 谁特么把女装拿上来的这不是害苦了朕吗第273章 不是这不是变身文吧
content_zh:
“wtf？！”
被敖青提醒了一下后，云阳当即用阵法搓出一面镜子。
话说用阵法搓镜子这事儿多少有点大炮打蚊子的感觉，人家一个“水镜术”就完事了，云阳这个“跳级”没怎么学过基础法术的，就只能用高端力量去完成非常基础的事了。
然而当云阳看到镜子中的自己时，瞬间就亚麻呆住了。
不施粉黛，却有玉珠之色，身姿窈窕，竟如天上仙女。
云阳本身的容貌就算比较拔尖的了，现在再加上敖润的润色……
啧，这姿色，就算比之苏沐雪都不遑多让。
如果胸部再大点，简直比苏沐雪还要略胜一筹！
不对！我特么怎么欣赏起来了？！
还有这头上有犄角，身后有尾巴的，自己成了物理意义上的“小龙女”？
等等！物理意义上？
云阳猛地低头检视自身，发现重要的两件核心出装并没有发生变化，其中脖子以下腹部以上的一件出装还往回扁了扁。
还好还好。
那也就是说……自己现在是男身女相？
我特么成女装大佬了？！
不可能！绝对不可能！
我云阳，就算是似，就算从这跳下去，都不可能女装的！
……
【任务：为敖丙寻找他的本命姻缘（已完成）】
【下一阶段任务：进入天琼秘境。】

“……”
在没了敖润这个拦路虎之后，敖丙和敖雨也是顺利勾搭上了。
呸！什么勾搭，那叫两情相悦！
只能说不愧是本命姻缘，还真是一眼定情，再见便是终身。
好吧说的夸张了点，还不到终身的程度，但两人的关系进展依旧相当之迅速。
所以云阳给敖丙放了个长假。
但却不是为了让敖丙去享受生活，而是云阳他自己需要静一静。
什么叫下一阶段的任务是进入“天琼秘境”？
这秘境云阳知道，之前在古岳城拍卖会上听大师姐和沐雪提过，这劳什子天琼秘境是一个大型界域破碎后落入此方界域的一个大型宗门，为了保证道统传承才将其改造成了一方秘境，而且只有元婴期以下的修士持“乾坤令”才能进去。
云阳也不知道这是瞌睡了送枕头，还是看见了枕头才感觉瞌睡的，但是……但是特么的……
自己说好不女装的啊！
想进去修为就得在元婴期以下，想把修为降到元婴期以下就得用那个契约法门，用那个法门就得“女装”。
再次强调一遍：自己说好不女装的啊！
content_en:
"wtf?!"
After being reminded by Ao Qing, Yunyang immediately used the formation to create a mirror.
It is said that using the formation method to rub the mirror is a bit like using a cannon to kill mosquitoes. People can do it with a "Water Mirror Technique". Yunyang, a "level skipper" who has not learned much basic spells, can only use high-end power to complete very basic things.
However, when Yunyang saw himself in the mirror, he was instantly stunned.
There is no powder applied, but it has the color of jade beads, and the figure is graceful and graceful, just like a fairy in the sky.
Yunyang's own appearance is quite outstanding, and now with Ao Run's polish...
Tsk, this beauty is even comparable to that of Su Muxue.
If her breasts were bigger, they would be slightly better than Su Muxue!
wrong! How come I appreciate it? !
And this one with horns on her head and a tail behind her has become a "little dragon girl" in the physical sense?
etc! In a physical sense?
Yunyang suddenly lowered his head and inspected himself, and found that the two important core items had not changed. Among them, the item below the neck and above the abdomen had flattened back.
Okay okay okay.
That means... I am now a man with a female form?
Have I become a crossdresser? !
impossible! Absolutely impossible!
Even if I, Yunyang, look like this, even if I jump from here, I can't possibly dress up as a woman!
…
[Task: Find Ao Bing’s natal marriage (completed)]
[The next stage of the mission: Enter the Tianqiong Secret Realm. 】
"..."
Without Ao Run as a stumbling block, Ao Bing and Ao Yu successfully hooked up.
Pooh! What kind of hookup is called mutual love?
All I can say is that it was a fateful marriage. It was true that love was sealed at first sight and we will be together for a lifetime.
Okay, that's a bit exaggerated, not even lifelong, but the relationship between the two is still progressing quite rapidly.
So Yunyang gave Ao Bing a long holiday.
But it was not for Ao Bing to enjoy life, but for Yunyang himself who needed some peace and quiet.
What is the next stage of the mission to enter the "Tianqiong Secret Realm"?
Yunyang knew about this secret realm. He had heard it mentioned by Senior Sister and Mu Xue at the Guyue City auction before. The Laoshizi Tianqiong secret realm was a large sect that fell into this realm after a large realm was broken. In order to ensure the inheritance of the Taoism, it was transformed into a secret realm. Only monks below the Nascent Soul stage holding the "Qiankun Order" can enter.
Yunyang didn't know whether he was given a pillow because he was sleepy, or whether he felt sleepy after seeing the pillow, but...but what the hell...
I said I don’t want to wear women’s clothes!
If you want to enter and cultivate, you have to be below the Nascent Soul stage. If you want to lower your cultivation to below the Nascent Soul stage, you have to use the contract method. To use that method, you have to "dress up as a woman."
Let me emphasize it again: I agreed not to dress up as a woman!
